name: Office Franchise Performance
query:
SELECT
  o.name as "Office:Link/Office:180",
  o.office_type as "Type::100",
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.name) as "Reps:Int:80",
  COUNT(DISTINCT ar.name) as "Assisted Requests:Int:140",
  COUNT(DISTINCT pva.name) as "Verifications Done:Int:150",
  COALESCE(SUM(fs.gross_commission_collected), 0) as "Gross Commission:Currency:150",
  COALESCE(SUM(fs.franchise_share), 0) as "Franchise Share:Currency:140"
FROM `tabOffice` o
LEFT JOIN `tabRep` r ON r.office = o.name
LEFT JOIN `tabAssisted Request` ar ON ar.rep = r.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPhysical Verification Appointment` pva ON pva.office = o.name AND pva.status = 'Completed'
LEFT JOIN `tabFranchise Settlement` fs ON fs.office = o.name AND fs.status = 'Settled'
GROUP BY o.name
ORDER BY o.name ASC
